what: The sections of this article, each with a line and a paragraph, for showing what the reader has already read. Built by admin/build/summaries.py from admin/content/articles/summaries/.

sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Why event platforms block sites like PrompTugal.news, who owns a listing, what the law allows, and how we collect now.
sections.para: A legal basis and evidence for every event.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Platforms forbid; organisers own; facts free; descriptions and photos not; guests never; our routes.

sections.label: The puzzle
sections.line: Organisers want their events seen and a listing sends traffic back, yet the platforms block it.

sections.label: What the platforms say
sections.line: Eventbrite and Partiful forbid scraping; Luma only its interfaces and no images; Meetup's API is paid.

sections.label: Who owns an event
sections.line: The organiser owns the listing; platforms hold non-exclusive licences and distribute to partners they choose.
sections.para: So the organiser can license us.

sections.label: What the law allows
sections.line: Facts free; descriptions and photos the author's; database right and contracts limit wholesale copying.

sections.label: What organisers expect
sections.line: Organisers rarely complain; scrapers are sold openly; the honest route is to ask the organiser.

sections.label: What we found about ourselves
sections.line: A storm-day house rule stopped our agents even reading the platforms' terms.
sections.para: Part of the block was us.

sections.label: How PrompTugal.news collects events now
sections.line: Official agendas, discovery for leads, facts and a link, organisers' submissions, a register, requests on record.

sections.label: What I would do next
sections.line: Read the terms, ask organisers, try organisers' interfaces, keep guests out, publish answers.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Not legal advice; some terms from archives; no platform has answered yet.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Platform terms, robots files, CJEU cases, statutes, the ICO and PrompTugal.news's events site.
